page.overview:
What is Seven Warlords of the Sea?

The Seven Warlords of the Sea, or simply the Seven Warlords, were a selection of seven incredibly powerful and notorious pirates by the World Government. Collectively, they comprised one of the Three Great Powers keeping the world in balance.

After two members (Crocodile and Donquixote Doflamingo) were exposed and arrested for undermining important kingdoms, Marine Admiral Fujitora led a campaign against the Warlords system, and during the next Levely a majority of kings voted to abolish it entirely. As a result, all of the remaining Warlords were reverted to wanted criminals. Currently, the World Government is advancing the SSG's Seraphim as a replacement.

The Seven Warlords of the Sea are a major group in the overall storyline, with most of its individual members encountering the Straw Hat Pirates at many different junctures, serving as both enemies and allies.

The Seven Warlords of the Sea were seven extremely powerful pirates who entered into the service of the World Government. The purpose of the Seven Warlords was to have them keep other pirates in check without the need of the Marines. They were also a great symbol of the government's strength. In return for their alliance with the World Government, every member's bounty was frozen (meaning that they would no longer be hunted by the World Government and that their bounties were deactivated), and they had significantly more leeway to commit crimes.
